copy.headline: CRUDE RECOVERS FASTER THAN FUEL
copy.deck: Banks estimate that global oil supply has returned toward surplus, yet Gulf refined-product exports remain near half their pre-war volume. Different recovery speeds expose a downstream bottleneck; reports and market signals are not proof of a newly completed system transition.
